errors.text: The proposed hot-extrusion route does not reconstruct ink extrusion printing, hydrogen de-binding, and prolonged vacuum sintering at 1400 °C.

It advocates nearly complete oxygen exclusion, whereas the target process deliberately maintains approximately 1.0 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening while using a titanium getter to prevent uncontrolled uptake.
It omits the 1500 °C water quench required to suppress alpha-HCP formation and retain metastable single-phase beta-BCC.
The claimed 350–400 °C completion of mixed Hf, Nb, Ta, Ti, and Zr hydride decomposition is unsupported and ignores their sequential decomposition according to hydride formation enthalpy.
It incorrectly frames the problematic alpha-HCP constituent as an oxide layer; the target is an oxygen-stabilized metallic alpha-HCP phase.
The proposed B2/Laves precipitation strategy contradicts the target single beta-BCC outcome and is not supported by evidence specific to HfNbTaTiZr.
The falsification rule is logically inverted: catastrophic cracking of the air/rapid-ramp sample would support, not falsify, the asserted need for vacuum and slow heating.
